text: To a 500 mL round-bottom flask equipped with a magnetic stir bar and a reflux condenser were charged racemic amine 1 (10.000 g, 37.128 mmol, 1.000 equiv) and l-diprogulic acid monohydrate (2) (10.852 g, 37.128 mmol, 1.000 equiv). iPrOH (180 mL, 0.2 M solution) was then added to the reactor vessel, and the mixture was heated to 80 °C for 1 h with stirring at 1000 rpm.

source.title: Heterogeneous Photochemical Process Intensification: Crystallization-Induced Dynamic Resolution of Amines
